description: § 453(i): equipment (cost $40,000, depreciation $20,000) sold for $50,000, $10,000 received this year. Gain $30,000; the § 1245 recapture $20,000 is taxed in full now (Form 6252 line 12, Form 4797 line 13). Line 14 = $50,000 − ($20,000 + $20,000) = $10,000 gross profit on a $50,000 contract price: 20% of $10,000 = $2,000 § 1231 gain. Schedule 1 line 4 $20,000; AGI $72,000.
